Certificate no.:                           Initial certification date:                  Valid:
277909-2018-AQ-NLD-RvA                     23 December 2012                             24 December 2024 – 23 December 2027




This is to certify that the management system of
Zalco B.V.
Frankrijkweg 2, 4389 PB Ritthem, Netherlands





has been found to conform to the Quality Management System standard:
ISO 9001:2015




This certificate is valid for the following scope:
The manufacture of aluminium extrusion billets and rolling slabs out of remelt material.
